input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: changepoint-detector flagship: multi-start V search for the covariate synthetic control (the covariate round's next item)

errors.what: misjudged elapsed time twice while waiting on the simulation and nearly redesigned the run around a wrong throughput estimate
errors.fix: checked CPU time per process with top before changing anything

doc_friction.issue: asks for venture-preflight (5+ min) on every changed venture; for a library-only eval change with no page edits it mostly re-checks unchanged pages
background tool calls cap at 30 min unless timeout is set explicitly; a watcher loop for a 90-min simulation was killed at the cap (the work itself ran on under nohup and was unaffected)

deviations.why: the six-start search costs ~6x, so 200 panels a cell would take ~5 h on four cores
deviations.did: pre-registered 80 panels a cell with size bars one point looser and said so in the file
deviations.result: ran in ~95 min; bar 1 failed in one cell (N7) by margins the 2.4-point standard error does not explain away for p<=0.10, so the smaller run still decided

notes: Pre-registered (eval/synth-multi-prereg-2026-11-17.md, committed before the confirmatory run and before any real state). Result: bar 3 (power) holds; 1 (N7 size 11.3%/17.5%), 2 (E1 16.3%) and 4 (CA rank 2, MA p 0.103, Oregon before-gap 17.5 vs 5.5) fail, so vSearch:'multi' stays an option. Post hoc: 4,000 random V never fit Oregon better than 15.8 packs; its 1970s level sits 40 packs above the donors and the lags (1983/1988/1996) never see it. No agent doc in docs/reports: README, NEXT.md and flagships.yaml carry the next step. Checks: synth-control.test.mjs, run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector and venture-preflight (results in the PR body).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician implementing a multi-start optimiser, a pre-registered simulation and a real-data diagnostic, about 1.5 days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
